audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was scored 'Akshan 3/10' while both prose fields on that row say Feast deters his all-ins and makes any swing into range a death sentence.
audit.why: Feast is instant true damage on an 80s cooldown; Comeuppance has to store bullets before it fires. Cho'Gath wins that race, and the Akshan-side audit already flipped its own level-6 row to Cho'Gath for exactly this reason. My side was the last one still saying Akshan.
audit.corrected: Level 6 flips to Cho'Gath at 6/10, matching the mirror and the prose already on the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike reference was 'Heroic Swing's cooldown' with no number, and Feast was called 'your committal tool'.
audit.why: Heroic Swing is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s and Avengerang 9/8/7/6/5s. The 18s rank-1 swing is a genuinely long window; the rank-5 12s is not. Advice that never names the number cannot be acted on.
audit.corrected: Windows keyed to Heroic Swing at 18s rank 1 falling to 12s, Avengerang at 9s, Feast at 80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The interaction line said only 'His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down.' The decisive interaction was never stated.
audit.why: Feral Scream's silence cancels Heroic Swing outright mid-arc — the Akshan-side audit reaches the same conclusion from the other direction and builds its whole don't-list around it. Separately, Comeuppance hits the first champion, minion or structure in the line, so a minion between you and him absorbs the entire salvo. Neither fact was anywhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Feral Scream (11s) cancels Heroic Swing outright; Comeuppance is a line shot a minion can body-block.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading text was the generic 'Q under Akshan's feet as he commits' template with pronoun bleed and no Akshan-specific content.
audit.why: Dirty Fighting shields him only on the third hit against a champion — a short trade denies the shield entirely, which is the actual trading rule here.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around cancelling the swing and denying the third Dirty Fighting hit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned that Cho'Gath has no escape from a swing cut-off.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/_missing/chogath.json flags terrain-cuts-retreat: Going Rogue's camouflage and Heroic Swing's terrain grapple both cut a retreat Cho'Gath has no dash to answer. Flash is for the wall, not the damage.
audit.corrected: Both Going Rogue and Heroic Swing cut your retreat and you have no dash — Flash the wall.

edits.before: Feast stacks turn you into terrain — every R is permanent HP plus a true-damage execute. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akshan's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Feast is instant true damage on an 80s cooldown while Comeuppance still has to store its bullets — you win that race, so any swing into your range is a death sentence.

edits.before: Weather the poke — silence his combo and out-scale with Feast stacks. Cho'Gath wins the Heroic Swing cooldown windows.
edits.after: Silence the swing and out-scale him. Feral Scream cancels Heroic Swing — that 11s window is the whole lane.

edits.before: Track Akshan's Heroic Swing: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Q-knockup + Feast the kill.
edits.after: Feral Scream (11s) cancels Heroic Swing outright — silence him mid-arc. Comeuppance is a line shot: a minion in front of you eats it.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heroic Swing: 18s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5 — Feral Scream (11s) cancels it outright, so silence beats chasing. - Avengerang is 9s and hits twice on one throw. - Going Rogue hides his approach. - Feast: 80s, kill windows only.

edits.after: Rupture him as he lands the swing, Feral Scream to cancel the arc, then E-spike — silenced, he is a marksman standing in melee range.

edits.after: 18s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5, and it needs terrain. Feral Scream cancels it mid-arc.
